newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says suspends Foodbrands America Inc.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says suspends Foodbrands America Inc.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Monday that trading in the common stock of Foodbrands America Inc will be suspended immediately.
The NYSE said that it normally considers suspending and removing from its list the securities of a company when fewer than 600,000 common shares are held by the public.
As result of the completion of a tender offer by IBP Inc which expired at midnight EDT on April 28, fewer than 600,000 shares of Foodbrands common stock remain publicly traded, the exchange said.
The NYSE noted that it may, at any time, suspend a security if it believes that continued dealings in the security on the NYSE are not advisable.
Following suspension, application will be made to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issue, it added.
